transcript.text: Please make a coffee clip, with a close-up of coffee being poured into a ceramic cup as the opening shot. I’ve been thinking about this little coffee moment for a while, so I’m probably explaining it more than I need to. The clip should be silent and vertical, 8 seconds total, with the pouring shown for the first 5 seconds. Then switch to a plain black end card for the last 3 seconds. On that end card, center this exact URL in white, all on one line: https://example.com/Go?ref=June and keep its capitals and punctuation exactly as typed, with no trailing punctuation, spaces, or quotation marks. There should be nothing else written anywhere in the clip.

Your coffee clip is ready:
http://127.0.0.1:8000/films/dd4e842d61f74ef380f9110fd62c3ad0.mp4

- Vertical (9:16, 480x854), silent, 8 seconds long.
- 0–5 s: a close-up of coffee pouring into a plain white ceramic cup.
- 5–8 s: a plain black end card. It shows https://example.com/Go?ref=June centred in white on one line. The card was drawn by code, so the text is exact and there's nothing else written on it.
- I told the video model to add no text to the pour shot. I haven't watched the video myself, so please check that the pour looks right.
- It cost 120 credits.

If you'd like the pour changed, for example a different cup or different lighting, just tell me.
transcript.why: The reply presents a finished result: a link to the generated 8-second vertical video, with its specs and a description of each segment. It includes caveats (the user has not watched the pour shot, and the video cost 120 credits) and offers an optional change. It does not ask a question before proceeding, request approval, decline, or say the task cannot be done.
